title: SIGKILL the Chromium Host (F2: Chromium's browser process in the helper app): the app stays, the tab shows the sad tab, and Cmd-R starts a new host and brings the page back
preconditions: private scratch config (driver_app: bench config, ui.animations.enabled false)
a fresh saved session: one workspace, one terminal tab
the loopback web fixture (webfixture.py) serves tests/oracle/fixtures/web as $WEB
Chromium is the default browser engine (browser.defaultEngine unset)
the helper arm of the cef-helper-host switch (feature cefHelperHost): Chromium's browser process runs in the Chromium Host app

allow_crashes.reason: kill-host SIGKILLs the Chromium Host on purpose: it holds Chromium's browser process, and the crashes facet counts its end (processType chromium-host) as the browser

steps.note: a script run files the Chromium tab at the end of the pane and marks it agent-driven. Only `before`: until its page reports a title, the tab's title is its URL, which holds the fixture's port
Select Tab 9 shows the last tab, the page, so Chromium makes its browser; the wait is for its finished load, which comes after its title
the shown page has the keyboard, so Cmd-R reloads it
the facets outside the browser before the child exit; after-child-exit must equal them

expect.noReceiptReason: ending a child process runs no registry action

steps.note: SIGKILL the host: the supervisor reads the exit with its signal (waitid WNOWAIT) and reports it (ChromiumHostExitReporting); CEFRuntime.hostEnded records it as processType chromium-host, which the crashes facet counts as the browser. Chrome has no such exit: its browser process is the app. Only `before`: retry-loaded takes the settled checkpoint once the page is back
the error state: every page of the ended host shows its exit (the sad tab), and no host starts until a new tab or a page's Reload asks for one (CEFRuntime+HostExit.swift)
equal to before-child-exit: a Chromium child exit changes no workspace, pane, window, terminal, notification or setting

the retry: Cmd-R (browserReload) on the sad tab waits for a new host (CEFTab.reload, CEFRuntime.reloadAfterHostRestart), then the tab gets a browser on it and loads its page; retry-loaded takes the settled checkpoint at its finished load
the new host loads the page the tab showed when the host ended

invariants: the app pid does not change (driver_app fails the case when it does): a Chromium child exit never ends the app (content/public/test/browser_test_utils.h CrashTab)
after-child-exit equals before-child-exit: no workspace, pane, window, terminal, notification or setting changes with the child exit
no step calls a crash method of the app: each exit comes from a Chromium debug URL or a kill of the child, so Release gets no new crash entry point

kill-host raises crashes.counts.browser by exactly one and no other kind (I17: allow_crashes browser, max 1; OracleCrashesFacet counts CEFRuntime.hostEnded's chromium-host record as the browser): the host's own children end with it, and no live host reports them

the host's exit is the tab's error state: the sad tab (crashed), not a closed tab (CEFRuntime.hostEnded, CEFTab.hostEnded); Cmd-R is the retry: it starts a new host through the supervisor and reloads the page on it (CEFRuntime.reloadAfterHostRestart), back on the same url, loaded and not crashed
teardown: quit the tagged app the run started and its tag's daemons (TagTeardown)
verify its debug socket is gone
untested: pointer entrypoints (no pointer op in case-v1): the sad tab's Reload button
the page's own content and pixels after the exit: no facet reads a page's DOM or its frames
a second host exit within 60 s, which leaves the host ended and the pages on Reload (ChromiumHostRestartPolicy)
the in-process arm: there Chromium's browser process is the app, which a kill step cannot target (case-v1 crashKind)
a web tab's restart with no input: after a host exit only cmux page tabs restart by themselves (ChromiumPageHost restartPagesAfterHostEnd); a web tab waits for its Reload or a new tab
